summary_en: This Phase II study tests elranatamab given in an outpatient setting, with a single dose of tocilizumab, in adults with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma. Elranatamab is given under the skin in step-up doses on Day 1 and Day 4, then 76 mg on Days 8, 15 and 22 of Cycle 1, every other week in Cycles 2 and 3, and once per cycle in Cycles 4 to 12, for up to 12 cycles of 28 days each. The main outcome is the overall incidence of cytokine release syndrome during Cycle 1.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase II evalúa elranatamab administrado en un entorno ambulatorio, junto con una dosis única de tocilizumab, en adultos con mieloma múltiple recidivante o refractario. El elranatamab se aplica debajo de la piel en dosis de inicio gradual el Día 1 y el Día 4, luego 76 mg los Días 8, 15 y 22 del Ciclo 1, cada dos semanas en los Ciclos 2 y 3, y una vez por ciclo en los Ciclos 4 a 12, hasta 12 ciclos de 28 días cada uno. El resultado principal es la incidencia global de síndrome de liberación de citocinas durante el Ciclo 1.
who_for: Diagnosed with multiple myeloma that has come back or did not respond to treatment.
Has had at least one prior line of therapy that included lenalidomide and an anti-CD38 antibody.
Able to do most daily activities (performance status 0 or 1).
At least 18 years old and willing to take antiviral and pneumonia prevention medicines.
not_for: Past grade 3 or higher cytokine release syndrome or immune effector neurotoxicity (ICANS).
Active central nervous system myeloma involvement.
Fever or active infection at the time of enrollment.
Hepatitis B infection or active hepatitis C infection.
Certain heart problems, or heart attack, stroke or similar event within 6 months.
